# Lilou Books (לילו בוקס)

> Lilou Books is an Israeli book-folding and book-sculpting art studio run by artist and workshop instructor Lahav Barak (להב ברק), based in Tel Aviv. It offers hands-on book-folding workshops for teams, companies, organizations, groups of friends and the general public, plus custom folded books made to order. Workshops are beginner-friendly, need no prior experience, and include all materials. Over 500 people have taken part.

## Workshops (סדנאות קיפול ופיסול ספרים)

- Team-building workshops for offices, companies and organizations (סדנת גיבוש לארגונים וחברות): up to 30 participants, 1.5–2 hours, at the client's office or at the studio. Special group pricing. Full details and quote request: https://liloubooks.com/team-building/
- Chanukah-Christmas workshop (סדנת חנוכריסמס): a festive holiday-season book-folding workshop for company Chanukah / end-of-year parties, diverse and international teams, and groups of friends. Book via https://liloubooks.com/team-building/#chrismukkah
- Private workshops for friends, family, birthdays and other celebrations (סדנה פרטית): 6–12 participants, 2–3 hours, each participant takes home a folded book.
- Open public workshops (סדנה קבוצתית פתוחה לקהל): regular sessions in a small group of 6–10 at the studio.

Details: https://liloubooks.com/#workshops

## Custom folded books and events

- Custom folded books with names, initials, symbols or logos, as personal gifts: https://liloubooks.com/#custom-orders
- Book-themed table design for weddings and events: https://events.liloubooks.com
